recommended_terminology: intrinsic metric star at the unique critical point
nearest_prior_work: Crane (2003), section 4.2, records the classical polynomial-preimage capacity law and the monic lemniscate specialization.
Jianu (2023), equation (13) and the following discussion, identifies |z^n-1|=1 as a sinusoidal spiral or lemniscate with n poles and decomposes the filled set into n rotated petals.
The sinusoidal-spiral curve family is classical and is traced by Jianu to Maclaurin's 1718 work.
classification.attribution: Use classical potential theory for capacity and sinusoidal spiral or n-pole lemniscate for the boundary curve. `Metric star' is acceptable descriptive metric language, not a standard priority-bearing name. Credit the card for extracting the exact intrinsic-distance corollary and capacity-normalized equality model.
classification.mathematical_interest: The geometry is elementary and highly symmetric, but it is the exact equality family any proposed capacity-geodesic inequality must reproduce. Its main value is as a sharp benchmark and falsifier, not as an isolated new theorem.
classification.reusable_scope: All affine images of z^n-1 at the unique critical level, and hence all monic quadratics with distinct roots after completing the square. No arbitrary polynomial or supercritical level follows.
classification.why_it_matters: It gives a scale-free equality model: every distinct-root intrinsic distance is exactly twice the logarithmic capacity. This calibrates constants without supplying the general inequality.

mathematical_delta.one_sentence: At the unique critical level of (z-tau)^n-lambda, the n-petal lemniscate is a metric star and every distinct-root intrinsic distance equals 2|lambda|^(1/n), exactly twice its capacity.
mathematical_delta.genuinely_hard_step: The benchmark is elementary; the real unresolved problem is obtaining any comparable intrinsic-geodesic bound once the forced central hub and petal symmetry disappear.
mathematical_delta.why_care: It supplies a scale-free equality model that can falsify constants in a general capacity-geodesic conjecture and prevents symmetric examples from being mistaken for arbitrary-polynomial progress.
mathematical_delta.natural_friction: The equality is critical-level only; supercritical mergers and general critical graphs have different intrinsic geometry.
